simple.meaning: טָרַח (ṭârach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to overburden.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 37:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָרַח (H2959) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H2959. tarach [ טָרַח ] verb toil, be burdened (Late Hebrew id., toil , Hiph`il weary, importune ; Aramaic טְרַח toil , etc.; Arabic is cast, throw, remove ) — Hiph`il Imperfect עָ֑ב יַטְרִיחַ אַףבְּֿרִי Job 37:11 he burdeneth with moisture the cloud(s).
